title: Reasoning Target + Context Composition Authority
authority_chain: Source -> Provenance -> Freshness -> Corroboration -> Quality / Anomaly -> Effective Observation -> Conflict / Escalation -> Evidence Lineage -> Observation Version -> Lifecycle / Retention -> Revocation / Rehabilitation -> Temporal Validity -> Instrument Binding -> Reasoning Target -> Context Composition -> Current Analytical Eligibility

OBDATA076.name: Reasoning-target identity
OBDATA076.rule: Every composition decision is bound to an explicit target ID, observation ID, observation version, symbol, instrument kind, and purpose.

OBDATA077.name: Upstream authority composition
OBDATA077.rule: All required upstream authority gates must be explicitly represented before analytical eligibility can be considered.

OBDATA078.name: Fail-closed eligibility verdict
OBDATA078.rule: BLOCK blocks, UNKNOWN fails closed, REVIEW requires review, and only unanimous ALLOW yields ELIGIBLE.

OBDATA079.name: Blocker/explanation preservation
OBDATA079.rule: Composition preserves gate verdicts, reasons, blockers, review gates, unknown gates, and reasoning-target identity.
